headline: Budsquire Choice
title: Budsquire Evolution | Thornblade or Melloblum | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Budsquire can become two different Aniimo, and both evolve at level twenty seven. For Thornblade, defeat a Thornblade while your party holds only a Budsquire. For Melloblum, finish the journey Flowers and Thorns, give it a Stamen of Cubbo's Rose, and make sure its personality contains Faithful. Thornblade is a Grass and Water attacker. Melloblum is a Grass support. Which one will you pick? Comment below!
description: Budsquire evolution in Aniimo: both Thornblade and Melloblum need level 27. Thornblade needs a win with a Budsquire-only party; Melloblum needs the Flowers and Thorns journey, a Faithful personality and a Stamen of Cubbo's Rose.
joke: Budsquire cries easily, but it has two very sharp career options.
